integrity: The proof independently identifies complete bounded-morphic quotients with domatic partitions, proves an exact 2^(n-1) maximum over all induced subframes by a Hall matching on complement pairs, and uses propositional coordinate formulas to realize the required Jankov--Fine fiber valuation inside the restricted translation semantics. The primary full text was inspected at Definition 6.1, Lemma 6.13, the Jankov--Fine criterion and its n=2 example, and the finite-hierarchy discussion. Targeted literature and indexed-finding searches did not locate strictness of every finite inclusion or the exact domatic invariant.
scientific_limitations: The theorem proves strictness of every adjacent finite stage but does not axiomatize the individual logics. The explicit Jankov--Fine separators are not claimed to be size- or variable-optimal. The quantitative quotient bound is specific to finite power-set compatibility frames.
title: Every finite stage of the internal forcing logic hierarchy is strict
